Degree Requirements
Our Website
Graduate Program Director: Dr. Uwe Tauber, gradphys@vt.edu
Graduate Coordinator: Betty Wilkins, gradphys@vt.edu
Graduate Student Handbook: online
CIP code: 40.0801
College: Science
Campus(es) where program is offered: Blacksburg
Minimum GPA: 3.0
TOEFL IBT: 4.5
TOEFL reading sub-score: 4.5
TOEFL listening sub-score: 4.5
TOEFL speaking sub-score: 4.5
TOEFL writing sub-score: 4.5
IELTS (TOEFL alternative): 6.5
GRE: optional
Letter(s) of recommendation: 3 required
Required supplemental materials:
Resume
Statement of purpose
Admission terms: Fall, Spring
Admission application deadlines:
Jan 5 for fall
Spring admissions are done on a case-by case basis. Applicants interested in Spring admission should contact the department before applying.
Institution code: 5859
Minimum total credit hours required for the degree: 92
Total minimum credit hour requirement of graded graduate-level courses: 32
Total minimum credit hour requirement of Research: 60
Core Courses
Classical Electromagnetism I
Quantum Mechanics I and II
Classical Mechanics
Statistical Mechanics
Methods of Theoretical Physics

Advanced Quantum Info Tech
Advanced Quantum Optics and Qubit Processors
Electromagnetism II
Introduction to Quantum Field Theory
Advanced Introduction to Nuclear Physics
Advanced Introduction to Particle Physics
Advanced Quantitative Analysis of Physics Experiments,
Solid-State Physics I
Solid-State Physics II
Advanced Polymer Physics
Intermediate Nanotechnology
Intermediate Optics
Advanced Modern Classical Physics
Advanced Modern Cosmology
Advanced Astroparticle Physics
Intermediate General Relativity
Statistical Mechanics II
Biophysics
Advanced Soft Matter Physics
Group Theory and its Applications in Physics I and II
Computational Physics
Advanced Quantum Theory I and II
Advanced Solid-State Physics
Elementary Particle Physics
Other Requirements
Two parts of Intro to Research Seminar, for first-year students
